g.title: Provides a read-optimized GraphQL API for the investor dashboard, aggregating portfolio performance, recent activity, and advisory status into dashboard-ready views.
Backend-for-frontend that provides a GraphQL API for the investor domain, serving portfolio summaries, account balances, and investor profile data to the investor-facing application.
Manages investor state by processing profile updates, risk tolerance changes, mandate grants, and operating mode transitions, maintaining the canonical investor record.

Guides new investors through the onboarding process using a conversational AI agent with a regulatory knowledge base to collect suitability information, risk preferences, and account details across a multi-phase wizard.
Ingests cross-domain events from the advisory, execution, and ledger buses into the investor domain bus, subscribing to decision packets, order status, balance updates, and reconciliation signals.
